identification: NOT von Guerard. Same composition as John Skinner Prout's 'The Cataract, Launceston' from Tasmania Illustrated (Hobart, 1844): rock stack at left, figure and fallen log on the path, gorge and river at right (matched against the NGV image found via Google Images). Hand-coloured lithograph, image approx 25 x 36 cm (Prout original is 26.2 x 36.2 cm), double-ruled border, caption below in one line 'THE CATARACTS, LAUNCESTON.'. The 1844 original's printed caption is 'THE CATARACT / LAUNCESTON.' in buff ink on two lines, so this may be a later issue or a reproduction. Gilt frame with cream mat.
